title: 第1章 催收第2章 水源第3章 练武

白洋县，张家沟。
烈日炎炎，李一山汗流浃背，将院子内的柴火，一担又一担的挑往王家，他乐此不疲，脸上流露出激动的笑容。
今年雨水不足，地里庄稼收成不好，为了填补家用，他每天上山砍柴，挑到集市上售卖，卖不出去就挑回来，堆在院子内。
好在所有的柴火，今日都被王家买走了。
虽然价钱打了折扣，但也解决了李一山一桩心事。
将院子内的柴火挑完后，李一山走到水缸边上，伸手刚抓住浮在水面上的水瓢，发现水缸里面，除了有自己的倒影之外，还多个年轻人。
“少东家，您来了。”
李一山急忙转身招呼道。
“我再不来，难道等着你主动将租金给交上？”
少东家神色不善。
手里拿着一个账本，翻开账面给李一山看，说道：“你在我家租了七亩田，租佃形式是定额租，每年十石米，你是交钱还是交米？”
“少东家，你也知道，今年地里收成不好，租金方面能不能减少两成，您看我家里都揭不开锅。”
李一山叫苦道。
“我家租给你的七亩地是上等水田，每亩年租一石五，已经给你少了半石米。你要是交不起租金，我只能把地收回来，相信会有人出更高的价格，排着队抢着要。”
少东家冷哼道。
“别，少东家，我没说不交，只是最近手头紧，您看能不能宽限一两个月。”
李一山祈求道。
“如果我没记错的话，你儿子跟我差不多年纪，不如这样，你要是真的缺钱，就把你儿子卖到我张家当奴才，不仅能省下今年的租金，我张家还能再给你一些银两。”
张凌风拍着李一山的肩膀道。

“这……少东家，您稍等。”
李一山面红耳赤，但想到张家在张家沟的权势，他只能回到屋里，将藏起来的银两取出来。
大庆王朝，正值丰收年，一石米售价三百文，十石米三千文，相当于三两银子。
张家一共有田产七百二十八亩。
上等水田占了五成。
中等田和瘠薄旱田各占了二至三成。
一半水田，自己雇佣长工管理，剩余一半，连同中等田和瘠薄旱田，都租佃出去。
租佃形式，有定额租，分成租，或者季节租，以及劳役地租几种方式。
收赁时间一到，张凌风就会带人上门催收。
连续几年和这些佃农打交道，张凌风早已弄清楚他们的套路，一旦松了口风，这伙人就会变本加厉，要想收齐租金，就得上点手段。
恐吓威胁只是常规操作，必要时候还得上点拳脚，见见血，才能镇得住这帮家伙。
从李一山家中出来后。
张凌风带着家里几个壮实的长工，来到了一座被他们张家田地包围住的鱼塘。
“少东家，这是给您准备好的花鲢，又肥又嫰，我费了好些手段，才逮住他。”
刘二老远就看到张凌风带着人过来，迅速从鱼排屋内出来，将准备好的花鲢双手递给张凌风。
身后一个长工接过花鲢。
张凌风默不作声，熟练的翻开账本，对着刘二说道：“今年雨水不足，鱼塘内的水，都是从我家田地引流过来，按照约定，今年鱼塘内的收成，我家占了三成，是交鱼还是交钱？”
“少东家，您也知道今年雨水不足，没有充足的鱼草，鱼苗根本长不大……”
刘二急忙说道。
张凌风不等他把话说完，道：“这附近所有的水渠，都是我们张家请劳役挖的，钱你可以不给，就是不知道，以后没有了溪水灌溉，单凭那点雨水，你家的水塘还能不能继续养鱼。”

“少东家，您稍等。”
刘二无可奈何，他可知道，眼前这家伙自从三年前性情大变后，说出来的话，都不是闹着玩的。
临走时，张凌风不仅收足了水钱，每个长工还都拎着几条鱼，他就这样，根据账本上的信息，挨家挨户的上门讨要租金。

Baiyang County, Zhangjiagou.
Under the scorching sun, Li Yishan was sweating profusely as he carried load after load of firewood from the yard to Wang's house. He enjoyed it endlessly, with an excited smile on his face.
There was insufficient rain this year and the crops in the fields were not harvested well. In order to make up for the household expenses, he went up the mountain to cut firewood every day and sold it at the market. If he couldn't sell it, he picked it back and piled it in the yard.
Fortunately, all the firewood was bought by the Wang family today.
Although the price was discounted, it also solved one of Li Yishan's worries.
After picking up the firewood in the yard, Li Yishan walked to the edge of the water tank, stretched out his hand to grab the water ladle floating on the water, and found that in addition to his own reflection, there were several young people in the water tank.
"Young master, you are here."
Li Yishan hurriedly turned around and greeted.
"If I don't come, will I wait for you to take the initiative to pay the rent?"
The young master looked unkind.
Holding a ledger in his hand, he opened the account and showed it to Li Yishan, and said, "You rented seven acres of land from my house. The form of tenancy is fixed rent, ten shi meters per year. Do you pay the money or the rice?"
"Young master, as you know, the harvest this year is not good. Can we reduce the rent by 20%? You see, my family can't even open the door."
Li Yishan cried bitterly.
"The seven acres of land my family rented to you are high-quality paddy fields. The annual rent per acre is one stone and a half, which is already half a stone less for you. If you can't pay the rent, I can only take the land back. I believe someone will offer a higher price and line up to get it."
The young master snorted coldly.
"No, young master, I didn't say I wouldn't pay, but I'm short of money recently. Do you think you can give me a month or two?"
Li Yishan prayed.
"If I remember correctly, your son is about the same age as me. Why not, if you are really short of money, sell your son to my Zhang family as a slave. Not only can you save this year's rent, but my Zhang family can also give you some more silver."
Zhang Lingfeng patted Li Yishan on the shoulder and said.
"This... Young Master, please wait a moment."
Li Yishan's face turned red, but thinking of the Zhang family's power in Zhangjiagou, he could only go back to the house and take out the hidden silver.
In the harvest year of the Daqing Dynasty, one stone of rice was sold for 300 Wen, and ten stone of rice was sold for 3,000 Wen, equivalent to three taels of silver.
The Zhang family has a total of 728 acres of land.
The top-grade paddy fields account for 50%.
Medium fields and barren dry fields each account for 20 to 30%.
Half of the paddy fields are managed by hiring long-term workers, and the remaining half, along with the medium-sized fields and barren dry fields, are rented out.
Tenancy forms include fixed rent, share rent, seasonal rent, and labor land rent.
When the lease collection time comes, Zhang Lingfeng will bring someone to collect the money.
After dealing with these tenant farmers for several consecutive years, Zhang Lingfeng has already figured out their tricks. Once they let go, this group of people will intensify their efforts. If they want to collect the rent, they must use some tricks.
Intimidation and threats are just routine operations. If necessary, you have to use some fists and blood to suppress these guys.
After coming out of Li Yishan's home.
Zhang Lingfeng took several strong long-term workers from his family to a fish pond surrounded by their Zhang family's fields.
"Young master, this is the silver carp prepared for you. It is fat and tender. I spent a lot of time to catch him."
Liu Er saw Zhang Lingfeng coming with someone from afar. He quickly came out of the fish shop and handed the prepared silver carp to Zhang Lingfeng with both hands.
A long-term worker behind him took the silver carp.
Zhang Lingfeng remained silent, opened the account book skillfully, and said to Liu Er: "There is insufficient rain this year, so the water in the fish pond is diverted from my family's field. According to the agreement, my family accounts for 30% of the harvest in the fish pond this year. Should I hand over the fish or pay the money?"
"Young master, you also know that there is not enough rain this year, and there is not enough fish and grass, so the fry will not grow big at all..."
Liu Er said hurriedly.
Zhang Lingfeng didn't wait for him to finish his words and said: "All the canals around here are mine."We, the Zhang family, hired laborers to dig it out. You don’t have to pay for it, but I don’t know if your pond can continue to raise fish with just that little rainwater without the stream for irrigation. "
"Master, please wait a moment. "
Liu Er was helpless. He knew that since the guy in front of him changed his temperament three years ago, nothing he said was a joke.
Before leaving, Zhang Lingfeng not only collected enough water money, but each long-term worker also carried a few fish. In this way, based on the information in the account book, he went door-to-door to ask for rent.
